Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Go
on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "privatedial" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "privatedial" ]
jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      NGROK_TEST_FLAKEY: 1
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
    - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@ba0dd844c9180cbf77aa72a116d6fbc515d0e87b # v27
    - uses: HatsuneMiku3939/direnv-action@fe6ca688de409566c44001c1e65ad6925f0e9cbb # v1
    - name: direnv allow
      run: direnv allow .
    - name: go mod tidy
      run: direnv exec . go mod tidy
    - name: exit if not tidy
      run: |
        git diff --exit-code go.mod
        git diff --exit-code go.sum
    - name: Build
      run: direnv exec . go build -v ./...
    - name: Build Examples
      run: direnv exec . go build -C ./examples -v ./...
    - name: Test
      run: direnv exec . go test -v ./...
  patched-go:
    name: Go ${{ matrix.go }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go: ['1.26.10', '1.27.3']
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      NGROK_TEST_FLAKEY: 1
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
    - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go }}
    - name: Build
      run: go build -v ./...
    - name: Build Examples
      run: go build -C ./examples -v ./...
    - name: Test
      run: go test -v ./...
  online-tests:
    name: Online tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    env:
      NGROK_TEST_ONLINE: 1
      NGROK_TEST_FLAKEY: 1
      NGROK_AUTHTOKEN: ${{ secrets.NGROK_AUTHTOKEN }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
    - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@ba0dd844c9180cbf77aa72a116d6fbc515d0e87b # v27
    - uses: HatsuneMiku3939/direnv-action@fe6ca688de409566c44001c1e65ad6925f0e9cbb # v1
    - name: direnv allow
      run: direnv allow .
    - name: Test
      run: direnv exec . go test -mod=readonly -v ./...

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
